items.title: Demo completion and moisture issue
items.summary: Demo was completed and moisture was found behind the shower wall.
items.action: Investigate the cause of the moisture and plan for remediation.
items.source_excerpt: 7/27 demo done. opened up the shower wall and there is moisture behind it

items.title: Shower framing photo

items.title: Tile start date inquiry
items.summary: The client inquired whether the moisture issue would delay the tile start date.
items.action: Respond to the client regarding the potential delay in tile start date.

items.title: Lopez site visit
items.summary: Lopez may visit the site on Thursday to assess the situation.

items.title: Vanity delivery delay

items.action: Follow up with the supplier to obtain a revised delivery date.
